entry.title: Explore Model Garden
entry.why: Compare Google-hosted model options for a specific task.
entry.status: Vendor documentation; access and model availability depend on the project and region.

briefing.purpose: Orient a model choice in Google Cloud Model Garden.
briefing.inputs: Task, modality, project, region and deployment constraints.
briefing.approach: Review current model cards, supported tasks, deployment options and provider terms.
briefing.outputs: A model candidate and project-specific checks still needed.
briefing.requirements: An eligible Google Cloud project and permissions to try or deploy a model.
briefing.limits: Browsing a model catalog does not grant access, deploy a model or demonstrate its quality for this task.
briefing.review_scope: Official Model Garden overview inspected; no project availability or deployment tested.
